title: Update now or wait?
hook: Compare two estimates from the same unfinished episode.

knows: The listed prerequisite concepts and small arithmetic.
doesNotKnow: Distinguish a bootstrap update before termination from a completed-return update.

misconception: Distinguish a bootstrap update before termination from a completed-return update.
objective: Distinguish a bootstrap update before termination from a completed-return update.

claims.text:
All finite inputs, equations, computed outputs and visual encodings: export function compare(next:number,r0=0,r1=4){const tdTarget=r0+.5*next,mcTarget=r0+.5*r1;return {tdTarget,td:.5*tdTarget,mcTarget,mc:.5*mcTarget};}
export function run(mode:number){return {finished:mode!==0,...compare(mode===2?4:10)};}
